title: Event definition (events/<name>.json), format version 1
description: One event that a mod defines. The key names are listed in include/match/modload/event_definition_keys.hpp; a test compares both. A mod defines ids only in its own namespace, and only the uni mod defines uni: ids (loader check `event.id.namespace`). A payload field that sets no audience has the audience `none`.

uni:format_version.description: Version of the file style. This build reads major version 1.

uni:identifier.description: Full event id, namespace:name. The namespace is the id of the defining mod.

uni:retention.description: How long the server keeps the event for a late joiner. The default is log.

uni:fields.description: Payload field name to its declaration.

uni:audience.description: Who may receive the field. The default is none.

uni:context.description: Streak values that the event requests. Streaks are a later ticket; the names are not resolved yet.
